capabilities: Expose vault notes to MCP clients through a local token-protected server
Search notes by keyword or optional semantic similarity and return cited evidence
Read note content, links, and properties, and sample the vault across folders
Optionally create and edit notes and Bases with revision conflict checks
Exclude private folders, files, or tags from client access
disambiguation: Not an AI model or chat interface itself; it only exposes vault tools over MCP to an external client that runs the model.
extras: Registry listing carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' README describes the development version and points to a changelog, security model, and skill installation guide hosted elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian vaults are not reachable by MCP chat clients, so users cannot ask questions over their notes with citations or let assistants read and edit notes under controlled access.

relations.evidence: Connect LM Studio or another MCP client to the Obsidian notes you choose to expose.

requires.name: MCP client with a tool-capable chat model (e.g. LM Studio) and Node.js 20+
External embedding endpoint for semantic search

summary: Local MCP server bridge that lets MCP clients such as LM Studio search, read, cite, and optionally edit vault notes through exclusion-based access control.
